wins.title: Shorten hydration gap
wins.save: 2407 ms average between FCP and interactive
wins.fix: Keep above-fold UI as server components, move interactivity to small client islands, and hydrate the splash and mega menu lazily.

wins.title: Reduce main-thread blocking (TBT)
wins.save: 703 ms average TBT at 4x CPU on 11 routes
wins.fix: Defer splash, animation and analytics scripts to requestIdleCallback, split long hydration with Suspense boundaries, avoid animating layout properties, and use CSS transform and opacity only.

wins.title: Preload or prioritise the LCP image
wins.save: about 300 to 700 ms LCP on 1 routes (/gallery)
wins.fix: Add priority (fetchPriority high, preload) to the first above-the-fold next/image on those routes and make sure it is not wrapped in a client-only component or hidden behind the splash.

wins.title: Trim font payload
wins.fix: Subset to Latin, limit weights, use next/font with display swap and preload only the body weight.

wins.title: Fix lazy loading
wins.save: 0 eager images below the fold and 25 lazy images in the first viewport
wins.fix: Remove priority from images past the first screen; ensure only the LCP image is eager; give grid cards loading lazy.

wins.title: Bring route JS under 200 KB gzip
wins.save: 31.8 KB on 11 routes, about 163 ms download plus parse
wins.fix: Run next build with the bundle analyzer, lazy load the cart, wizard, splash, mega menu and consent code with next/dynamic after first paint, and drop unused libraries.

wins.title: Reduce request count
wins.fix: Lazy load below-fold images and sections, merge small chunks, avoid eager prefetch of every card link on slow networks.

wins.title: Shrink HTML payload
wins.fix: Paginate or lazy render long grids, trim RSC payload props (pass ids not full objects) on listing pages.

wins.title: Serve images at the right width
wins.save: 260.3 KB across routes, about 121 ms per page
wins.fix: Tighten the sizes attribute on every next/image to the real CSS width (for example 50vw on two-column grids) and trim images.deviceSizes and imageSizes so the chosen srcset width is within 1.5x of CSS width times dpr.

wins.title: Add an offline fallback
wins.save: no white or browser error screen when data drops
wins.fix: Register a small service worker that caches the app shell, an /offline page and the last visited product pages; keep the order draft in localStorage (already mk.draft.v1).
